name: AI BotKit – AI Chatbot & Live Chat for WordPress (No-Code)
author: WisdmLabs

sections.description:
AI BotKit helps WordPress site owners easily add an AI chatbot trained on their own website content. The chatbot understands visitor questions and provides accurate, context-aware responses using modern AI models.

AI BotKit is an easy-to-use AI chatbot plugin for WordPress. It works without coding and can be trained using your own Website pages, posts, PDFs, or external URLs. Once set up, the chatbot helps visitors find information, get answers instantly, and interact with your website more effectively.

Create your Chatbot in 5 mins | Take Demo | Pricing | Documentation | Support

Add a smart ChatGPT-powered AI chatbot to your WordPress site, automate customer support, answer FAQs, and capture leads around the clock.

⚡ How AI BotKit Works

Step 1: Connect Your Website
Install AI BotKit directly from your WordPress dashboard and activate it like any standard plugin. No technical configuration or setup complexity required.

Step 2: Build Your Knowledge Base
Choose the content you want the chatbot to learn from WordPress pages, posts, uploaded PDF documents, or external links. AI BotKit automatically processes this content and builds a structured knowledge base.

Step 3: Go Live Instantly
Enable the chatbot on your website and start assisting visitors in real time. The chatbot stays active 24/7, answering questions and guiding users whenever they visit your site.

What does AI BotKit do?

AI BotKit helps you add a smart, ChatGPT-powered chatbot to your WordPress site in just a few minutes — no coding required.
The chatbot learns from your website content and provides accurate, context-aware answers to visitor questions. This helps improve engagement, reduce support requests, and convert visitors into leads.

Use it to:

  • Answer visitor questions instantly
  • Guide users through pages or products
  • Collect leads and feedback through chat
  • Provide 24/7 multilingual support

Why use AI BotKit on your WordPress website?

✅ Why Choose AI BotKit?

⏱️ Quick and Easy Setup
AI BotKit is designed for WordPress users who want results without complexity.
Install the plugin, select your content, and enable the chatbot, all from your WordPress dashboard. No technical setup or learning curve required.

This makes it ideal for users searching for an easy-to-install AI chatbot plugin for WordPress.

🤖 Smart AI Responses
AI BotKit uses modern AI models to understand visitor questions and respond naturally.
Instead of fixed replies, the chatbot answers based on context, creating a more helpful conversation experience.

This is useful for users looking for a smarter alternative to basic WordPress chatbots.

📚 Learns Directly From Your Website Content Choose tone, colors, avatar, chat style, and placement to match your site.
Your chatbot can learn from:

  • WordPress pages and posts
  • PDF files uploaded to your site
  • External links or documentation pages

When you update your content, the chatbot stays in sync automatically. You control what the bot should know, no manual training required.

This supports users searching for chatbots that work with existing WordPress content.

🎯 Built Specifically for WordPress
Everything is managed inside WordPress:

  • No third-party dashboards
  • No extra logins
  • No external tools to manage

AI BotKit works like a native WordPress plugin, making it easy for developers, site owners, and agencies to maintain.

🔐 Privacy-Focused and GDPR Ready
AI BotKit is built with privacy in mind.
You remain in control of your website data, and the plugin supports GDPR-compliant usage.

This is important for businesses and professionals who care about data security and compliance.

💰 Transparent Pricing
AI BotKit offers a free version with core chatbot functionality so users can try it before upgrading.
Advanced features are available through optional paid plans with clear pricing and no hidden charges.

This helps users who are exploring or comparing AI chatbot plugins for WordPress.

🎨 Easy Customization (No Coding Required)
You can customize the chatbot to match your website:

  • Adjust colors and appearance
  • Choose chatbot tone
  • Set greeting and fallback messages
  • Control widget placement

All settings are available through a simple interface — no code edits needed.

🌍 Multilingual Support
AI BotKit supports 50+ languages, making it suitable for global websites and multilingual audiences.

For advanced features, upgrade to AI Botkit Paid Plan

Top Features of AI BotKit WordPress Plugin

🧩 Create & Manage

  • Build multiple chatbots for different pages, funnels, or audiences
  • No-code builder to define bot purpose, tone, and behavior
  • Flexible Embed: floating launcher or inline widget

📚 Train & Personalize

  • Train on WordPress pages/posts, PDFs, or external links
  • Central knowledge base reusable across all bots
  • “Train Once, Answer Forever” engine — updates automatically

🎨 Customize the Look & Feel

  • Custom avatar, bubble design, font, size, and color
  • Choose between Professional, Friendly, or Casual tone presets
  • Fully multilingual chatbot for 50+ languages

📊 Leads & Analytics

  • In-chat lead capture To collect names, emails, feedback
  • Usage insights: See chat counts, response rates, and errors

🔗 Integration & Compatibility

  • Easy WordPress Integration: install directly from dashboard
  • WooCommerce Integration (coming soon): answer product queries, recover carts
  • Integration with Popular Services: connect leads to your favorite tools

🔒 Security & Compliance

  • 100% GDPR-compliant
  • Data processed securely within your site
  • Built with enterprise-grade privacy in mind

Why AI BotKit Stands Out

Unlike generic bots, AI BotKit is made for WordPress — light, simple, and powerful.
It’s designed to help businesses, bloggers, and creators use AI chatbots without any tech setup.
And with WisdmLab’s 10+ years of WordPress experience, you get reliability, performance, and genuine support.

Who should use an AI Chatbot?

AI BotKit is made for anyone who wants to convert their website traffic into leads and automate customer support. sections.installation:
Installation

  1. Go to plugins -> Add New in your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Search AI BotKit, install, and activate.
  3. You will be redirected to Welcome page.
  4. If you already have AI BotKit Chatbot Copy WordPress Code from Your Chatbot
  5. If Not Follow the Onboarding Wizard and create your first Chatbot
  6. Activate Chatbot or your site/pages.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher
sections.faq:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q: How does AI BotKit work?

A: It creates a private knowledge base from your site’s content, then answers visitor questions in real time through the chat widget.

Q: Can I train on PDFs and external pages?

A: Yes – you can upload PDFs or add URLs to include external content.

Q: Will it support lead capture?

A: Yes – the lead-capture module is available to all Pro users.

Q: Is it multilingual?

A: Yes – AI BotKit supports 50 + languages, perfect for global users.

Q: Where is my data stored?

A: Your Data is secured on our server securely. See our privacy Policy for details.

Q: Who built AI BotKit?

A: AI BotKit is proudly built by WisdmLabs, a trusted WordPress agency with 10 + years of experience building plugins and automation tools for global clients.

Q: Can I customize the chatbot appearance?

A: Yes, you can fully customize your chatbot’s appearance using our intuitive visual editor, without needing any CSS or coding skills.
